description: This exam certifies CEFR level B1 in Tagalog. Passing it means you can deal with most situations that come up while travelling in the Philippines, produce connected speech and text on familiar topics, describe experiences, events, hopes and plans, and give brief reasons and explanations for your opinions. The questions weight the core machinery of the level: choosing among the four verb focuses, ability and accident forms, the causative, particle stacking, conditionals, relative clauses, and reported speech — plus register control and reading comprehension.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means 'I ate the mango' (a specific mango)?
questions.explain: A definite object ('the mango') must be the ang-phrase, which requires object focus: kinain ko ang mangga.

questions.prompt: Sino ang ___ ng huling tiket? (Who bought the last ticket? — completed, actor focus)
accept: bumili
questions.hint: Sino ang...? asks about the actor.
questions.explain: Sino ang...? puts the actor in the ang slot, so the verb is actor focus: bumili.

questions.prompt: 'Binilhan ko ng pandesal ang panaderya.' What does the sentence say?
choices: I bought pandesal for the bakery.
I bought pandesal from the bakery.
questions.explain: Locative -an focus promotes the source: the bakery is where the pandesal was bought from.

questions.tl: Ibinili ko ng bagong payong ang nanay ko kasi nawala ang luma niya.
questions.prompt: What did the speaker do?
choices: Bought a new umbrella for their mother because her old one got lost
Bought a new umbrella from their mother
questions.explain: Ibinili (benefactive i-) makes the mother the beneficiary in focus; nawala (accidental ma-) explains the old umbrella got lost.

questions.prompt: ___ mo ang mga pinggan bago tayo umalis. (Wash the dishes — they're definite)
accept: hugasan
questions.explain: A command over a definite object uses the non-actor infinitive: hugasan mo ang mga pinggan.

questions.prompt: Ana bought fish for her mother at the market. (beneficiary in focus)
questions.answer: Ibinili ni Ana ng isda ang nanay niya sa palengke.
accept: Ibinili ni Ana ng isda ang nanay niya sa palengke
Ibinili ni Ana ang nanay niya ng isda sa palengke
Ibinili ni Ana ng isda sa palengke ang nanay niya
Ibinili ni Ana ng isda ang kaniyang nanay sa palengke
questions.explain: Benefactive focus i- puts the mother in the ang slot; Ana demotes to ni Ana, the fish to ng isda.

questions.prompt: Which question–answer pair matches focus correctly?
choices: Ano ang binili mo? — Bumili ako ng sapatos.
Ano ang binili mo? — Binili ko ang sapatos na ito.
Sino ang bumili? — Binili ni Ana.
questions.explain: Ano ang binili mo? is an object-focus question, so the answer keeps object focus: binili ko ang sapatos na ito.

questions.prompt: Your friend's glass slipped from your hand and broke. The honest, natural report is:
questions.explain: Accidental events take na-: nabasag ko = I accidentally broke it. Binasag would mean you did it on purpose.

questions.prompt: Hindi ako ___ kagabi dahil sa sobrang init. (I couldn't sleep last night)
accept: nakatulog
questions.explain: Whether sleep was achieved uses maka-: hindi ako nakatulog = I didn't manage to sleep.

questions.tl: Naiwan ko ang pasaporte ko sa hotel kaya bumalik pa kami bago pumunta sa paliparan.
questions.prompt: What happened?
choices: They lost their passport at the airport
They left their passport at the hotel, so they went back before going to the airport
The hotel kept their passport on purpose
They forgot to book the hotel near the airport
questions.explain: Naiwan ko = accidentally left behind; kaya introduces the consequence — returning before heading to the airport.

questions.prompt: Nakapunta na ako sa Bohol, pero hindi pa ako nakakakain ng balut.
questions.answer: I've been to Bohol, but I haven't been able to eat balut yet.
accept: I've been to Bohol, but I haven't been able to eat balut yet
I have gotten to go to Bohol but I still haven't tried balut
I've already been to Bohol, but I haven't eaten balut yet
questions.explain: Maka- + na = achieved experience ('have been'); hindi pa nakakakain = haven't yet managed to eat.

questions.prompt: 'I got a haircut before the interview.' Which is correct?
choices: Ginupit ko ang buhok ko bago ang panayam.
questions.explain: Magpa- means you caused someone else to do it: nagpagupit ako = I had my hair cut. Choice 1 says you cut it yourself.

questions.prompt: ___ ko na ang sirang aircon sa teknisyan. (I already had the broken aircon fixed — thing in focus)
accept: ipinaayos
questions.explain: The definite aircon in focus takes ipa-: ipinaayos ko ang aircon sa teknisyan.

questions.prompt: 'Pinaluto ko si Ben ng pansit.' Who cooked the pansit?
questions.explain: Pa--in focuses the person made to do it: si Ben was had to cook; the speaker only caused it.

questions.tl: Magpapadala ako ng pera sa pamilya ko bukas kasi pista sa amin sa Linggo.
questions.prompt: What will the speaker do?
choices: Travel home for the fiesta on Sunday
Send money to their family tomorrow because of the fiesta on Sunday
Ask the family to send money for the fiesta
questions.explain: Magpapadala (contemplated magpa-) = will send/have delivered; the reason is the hometown fiesta on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly says 'I'm scared', not 'I'm scary'?
questions.explain: The experiencer uses na-: natatakot ako. Nakakatakot ako announces that you frighten people.

questions.prompt: ___ ang biyaheng walong oras nang walang tulog. (An eight-hour trip without sleep is exhausting)
accept: nakakapagod
nakapapagod
questions.hint: The adjective for a thing that causes tiredness.
questions.explain: The cause of the feeling takes nakaka-: nakakapagod ang biyahe.

questions.prompt: Don't worry — I'll call you when I arrive.
questions.answer: Huwag kang mag-alala — tatawagan kita pagdating ko.
accept: Huwag kang mag-alala, tatawagan kita pagdating ko
Huwag kang mag-alala tatawagan kita pagdating ko
Huwag kang mag-alala — tatawagan kita kapag dumating ako
Huwag kang mag-alala, tatawagan kita pagdating ko diyan
questions.explain: Huwag + ka + -ng + mag-alala for the prohibition; pagdating ko (or kapag dumating ako) for 'when I arrive'.

questions.prompt: Your friend just revealed something that contradicts what you assumed. Which particle marks your reaction? 'Kapatid mo ___ siya!'
questions.explain: Pala marks surprised realization — you just learned it and had assumed otherwise.

questions.prompt: Which sentence stacks the particles in the correct order?
questions.explain: Short particles precede long ones: na before nga before pala. The others break pronoun or particle order (ka ba na, pa rin reversed, na naman reversed).

questions.prompt: Sino ___ ang kumatok sa pinto nang hatinggabi? (I wonder who knocked at midnight?)
accept: kaya
questions.explain: Enclitic kaya turns the question into speculation: 'I wonder who...'

questions.tl: Naiwan ko na naman ang susi ko sa bahay; hindi tuloy ako makapasok sa opisina.
questions.prompt: What is the speaker's problem?
choices: They left their key at home again, so now they can't get into the office
They lost their office key inside the office
They gave their key to a coworker at home
questions.explain: Na naman = again; tuloy marks the unwanted result: hindi tuloy ako makapasok — 'so now I can't get in'.

questions.prompt: Oh fine, I'll come along — but let's eat first.
questions.answer: Sige na nga, sasama ako — pero kumain muna tayo.
accept: Sige na nga, sasama ako pero kumain muna tayo
Sige na nga sasama ako, pero kain muna tayo
Sige na nga, sasama na ako pero kumain muna tayo
questions.explain: Sige na nga is reluctant surrender; muna sequences the eating before leaving.

questions.prompt: The most polite way to disagree with a colleague's plan:
choices: Hindi ako papayag, tapos ang usapan.
Naiintindihan ko ang punto mo, pero medyo iba ang tingin ko.
questions.explain: Professional Tagalog acknowledges first, then counters with a hedge: acknowledgment + pero + softened view.

questions.prompt: Sa isang banda, mas mura sa probinsya. Sa ___ banda, mas maraming trabaho sa Maynila. (on the other hand)
accept: kabilang
questions.explain: Weighing sides uses sa isang banda... sa kabilang banda... — on one hand... on the other.

questions.prompt: '___ umuulan, nagba-baha sa kalye namin.' (Whenever it rains, our street floods.) Which word?
questions.explain: A recurring, expected situation takes kapag with the incompleted aspect. Kung would cast doubt on whether it ever rains.

questions.prompt: Kung nag-aral ka nang mabuti, pumasa ka ___ sa pagsusulit. (If you had studied well, you would have passed.)
accept: sana
questions.explain: Unreal past conditions pair kung + completed verb with sana in the result: pumasa ka sana.

questions.prompt: If I were you, I would accept the job offer.
questions.answer: Kung ako sa iyo, tatanggapin ko ang alok na trabaho.
accept: Kung ako sa iyo, tatanggapin ko ang alok na trabaho
Kung ako sa'yo, tatanggapin ko ang alok na trabaho
Kung ako sa iyo, tatanggapin ko ang job offer
Kung ako sa iyo tatanggapin ko ang alok
questions.explain: The advice frame kung ako sa iyo takes a contemplated verb: tatanggapin ko (object focus — the offer is definite).

questions.tl: Simula nang lumipat kami malapit sa opisina, hindi na ako naaabutan ng trapiko tuwing umaga.
questions.prompt: What changed for the speaker?
choices: Since moving near the office, they no longer get caught in morning traffic
They moved because traffic got worse every morning
They started commuting earlier to avoid traffic
Their office moved away from the traffic
questions.explain: Simula nang + completed verb = since the move; hindi na naaabutan ng trapiko = no longer caught by traffic.

questions.prompt: 'The book that Ana bought' is:
choices: ang libro na si Ana bumili
questions.explain: The book is the object of the buying, so the relative verb takes object focus: binili, with Ana as ni Ana.

questions.prompt: Hindi ko alam ___ saan sila lilipat sa susunod na buwan. (I don't know where they're moving next month.)
accept: kung
questions.hint: Embeds a question inside a statement.
questions.explain: Embedded questions take kung + question word: kung saan, kung sino, kung kailan.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct nominalization? 'Cooking is her passion.'
questions.explain: Mag- verbs nominalize with pag- + doubled syllable: magluto > pagluluto, 'the activity of cooking'.

questions.prompt: Kilala mo ba ang lalaking nakaupo sa tabi ng babaeng nakasuot ng pula?
questions.answer: Do you know the man seated next to the woman wearing red?
accept: Do you know the man seated next to the woman wearing red
Do you know the man sitting beside the woman in red
Do you know the man who is seated next to the woman dressed in red
questions.explain: Two stacked relative clauses: nakaupo (seated) describing the man, nakasuot ng pula (wearing red) describing the woman.

questions.prompt: Which correctly reports 'She said she can't come'?
choices: Sinabi niya kung hindi siya makakarating.
Sabi niya ba hindi siya makakarating.
questions.explain: Reported statements attach with na/-ng: sinabi niyang + clause. Kung would mean 'whether'; ba is banned in reports.

questions.prompt: Kain na ___ kayo, sabi ni Lola. (Grandma says come and eat now — relay particle)
accept: raw
daw
questions.hint: Marks relayed words; this position follows a vowel.
questions.explain: Relaying someone's words takes daw/raw — raw after the vowel of 'na': kain na raw kayo.

questions.tl: Tinanong ko ang guwardiya kung saan ang opisina ng HR, at itinuro niya agad ang ikatlong palapag.
questions.prompt: What happened?
choices: The guard asked the speaker where HR was
The speaker asked the guard where the HR office was, and he pointed to the third floor right away
The speaker couldn't find the guard on the third floor
The HR office asked for a guard
questions.explain: Tinanong ko ang guwardiya = I asked the guard (person in focus); kung saan embeds the question; itinuro = pointed out.

questions.prompt: On the phone, a stranger answers. The politest way to ask for Mr. Santos is:
choices: Puwede ko po bang makausap si G. Santos?
Ibigay mo kay Santos ang telepono.
questions.explain: The professional formula is puwede + po + ba + makausap — 'may I please speak with...'.

questions.prompt: Could our meeting be moved to Thursday? (polite, with po)
questions.answer: Puwede po bang ilipat sa Huwebes ang pulong natin?
accept: Puwede po bang ilipat sa Huwebes ang pulong natin
Puwede po bang ilipat ang pulong natin sa Huwebes
Maaari po bang ilipat ang miting natin sa Huwebes
Puwede po bang ilipat ang miting natin sa Huwebes
questions.explain: Ilipat (i- focus) moves the definite meeting; puwede po ba frames the request politely.

questions.prompt: ___ kami ng gasolina sa gitna ng bundok, buti na lang may dala kaming reserba. (We ran out of gas...)
accept: naubusan
questions.explain: Running out hits the victims: naubusan kami ng gasolina — the adversative na--an with the thing as ng.

questions.tl: Pagdating namin sa terminal, biglang bumuhos ang ulan, kaya naghintay muna kami bago sumakay ng bangka.
questions.prompt: What is the sequence of events?
choices: They boarded the boat in the rain right away
On arriving at the terminal, rain suddenly poured, so they waited before boarding the boat
The boat left them because of the rain
They arrived after the rain had stopped
questions.explain: Pagdating namin = upon our arrival; biglang bumuhos = suddenly poured; muna = first (waited) before boarding.

questions.prompt: READING. 'Tuwing Sabado, pumupunta si Aling Rosa sa palengke. Kahapon, binili niya ang pinakasariwang bangus sa puwesto ni Mang Tomas. Suki niya ito, kaya laging may kaunting dagdag ang bigay nito. Bago umuwi, ibinili niya ng tsokolate ang kaniyang apo dahil kaarawan nito bukas.' — Why did Aling Rosa buy chocolate?
choices: Because it was on sale at Mang Tomas's stall
Because her grandchild's birthday is tomorrow
Because she is a regular customer
Because the milkfish was too expensive
questions.explain: Ibinili niya ng tsokolate ang kaniyang apo — she bought it for her grandchild — dahil kaarawan nito bukas, because its birthday is tomorrow.

questions.prompt: READING. 'Nag-aplay si Sofia sa isang kompanya sa Makati. Pagdating ng araw ng panayam, dumating siya nang maaga at magalang na bumati sa lahat. Nang tanungin siya kung bakit siya nagbitiw sa dati niyang trabaho, sinabi niyang gusto niya ng mas malaking hamon. Makalipas ang tatlong araw, tinawagan siya ng kompanya: tinanggap siya sa posisyon.' — What happened three days after the interview?
choices: The company called her to say she was accepted
She was asked to a second interview
She resigned from the new company
questions.explain: Makalipas ang tatlong araw, tinawagan siya ng kompanya: tinanggap siya — after three days, the company called: she was accepted.

questions.prompt: READING. 'Dalawang araw bago ang pista, may paparating daw na bagyo ayon sa ulat. Kinagabihan, lumakas ang hangin at nagbrownout sa buong barangay. Kung hindi sana inilipat ng mga kabataan ang mga upuan at tolda, nasira sana ang lahat. Pagkalipas ng bagyo, naglinis ang lahat sa diwa ng bayanihan, at natuloy pa rin ang pista kinabukasan.' — Which statement is TRUE?
choices: The fiesta was canceled because of the typhoon
The chairs and tents were destroyed by the storm
The young people moved the chairs and tents, so nothing was ruined, and the fiesta pushed through
The barangay had no electricity for a week after the storm
questions.explain: The unreal conditional (kung hindi sana inilipat... nasira sana) tells us the moving DID happen and the ruin did NOT; natuloy pa rin ang pista — the fiesta pushed through.

questions.prompt: I asked her where she bought the bag, and she said she had it made by a friend.
questions.answer: Tinanong ko siya kung saan niya binili ang bag, at sinabi niyang ipinagawa niya raw ito sa kaibigan.
accept: Tinanong ko siya kung saan niya binili ang bag, at sinabi niyang ipinagawa niya ito sa kaibigan
Tinanong ko siya kung saan niya binili ang bag at sabi niya ipinagawa raw niya ito sa kaibigan
Tinanong ko siya kung saan niya binili ang bag, at sabi niya, ipinagawa niya raw ito sa kaibigan niya
questions.explain: The whole level in one line: tanungin + embedded kung saan, object focus binili for the definite bag, reported sinabi niyang/sabi niya (optionally with raw), and causative ipinagawa — had it made.
